# A little help on the way.

Installation trouble, a server question, or a community concern? Start with the right channel.

## Community support

Discord is the home for player support, announcements, bug reports, and build sharing.

 [Open Discord](https://discord.gg/QQwdEgFMFg)

## Contact the operator

 [Official contact →](mailto:admin@mythforge.win)

## Help us help you

For technical issues, include the modpack version, launcher, allocated RAM, and relevant log or crash report. For reports or appeals, include the time and context of the incident.
